description: Gigi welcomes students to the classroom, asks how their day is going, and responds with empathetic gestures.

actions.text: Good morning everyone! Welcome to class!
How is everyone feeling today? Are you ready to learn?

transitions.condition: 'good' in str(student_mood).lower() or 'ready' in str(student_mood).lower() or 'yes' in str(student_mood).lower()

actions.text: Fantastic! I am thrilled to explore new ideas with you today!
I understand! Let's take it one step at a time. It's going to be a great day!
